manifest.title: Bring chaff into a document folder (shelve today's findings)
manifest.description: Brings chaff into a folder of documents you already have. It places a chaff.yaml that fits the kind of documents, shelves today's findings with chaff baseline, and from then on only new findings appear. If you want, it also makes a workflow that shows findings on the lines of a GitHub PR. The originals do not change.

places.label: The documents for chaff to watch (one folder or file in this folder per line)
places.why: Today's findings in these documents are shelved, and from then on only new findings here appear

kind.label: What kind of documents are they?
kind.why: chaff measures them with the yardstick for that kind of document (how long a sentence may be, which checks to run)

options.会社のサイトの記事（オウンドメディア）: An article on a company site
options.演説・挨拶の原稿: Speech or address (to be read aloud)
options.書き起こし（会見・会議での発言の記録）: Transcript (what was said at a press conference or meeting)

ci.label: Show findings on GitHub PRs?
ci.why: If made, chaff runs every time a PR is opened, and new findings appear on their lines

options.GitHub の PR に指摘を出すワークフローを作る: Make a workflow that shows findings on GitHub PRs
options.作らない（手元で npx chaffjs を動かす）: Don't make one (run npx chaffjs on your own machine)

survey.title: Measure today's findings
survey.description: Measures how many findings the documents have now, for the chosen kind, and drafts the settings to put in. Nothing changes yet.

apply.title: Bring chaff in
apply.description: Places chaff.yaml, shelves today's findings in .chaff-baseline.json, and, if you want, adds a workflow that shows findings on PRs. Checks by machine that from then on only new findings appear.

help-pages.title: Bring chaff into help pages
help-pages.description: Measures the sample help pages (login.md and export.md) as "Procedure, help or manual", shelves today's findings (a dropped-ら verb form and a "here" link that does not say where it goes), and from then on only new findings appear. It also makes a workflow that shows findings on GitHub PRs. The originals do not change.
